text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I am utterly ashamed. To think... I've 
gained... weight..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll put it back right away. ...I'll do 
my best...!
choice_data_list: Forcing yourself to do it is just……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It'll just cause stress, and I don't feel 
that's good. Isn't there a way we can make 
it fun—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you alright? Walking this much... 
Did you push yourself too hard for my 
sake...?"
choice_data_list:
I-It's not impossible! Besides, it's 
fun...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hiking trip planned just for her. I have 
to make sure not to worry her, or else 
she'll try to turn back out of feeling 
guilty.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(They're trying not to make me worry... I 
don't want them pushing themselves... but 
I also don't want their consideration to 
go to waste...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I-I have to pretend I didn't notice... 
otherwise, they might collapse like 
this...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...! Um... From here on, I'd... like to 
try running a little, if that's 
alright...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will... return right away. Please 
do not worry. ...Please, believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just running back here is quite a 
distance... And it's in the mountains, no 
less. My worries are endless, but—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! Thank you very much... I won't keep you 
waiting... I will see this course you've 
prepared through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... hah, hah... I-I'm... back...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Yes, I'm alright... Just 
thinking... that you were waiting for 
me... I was able to... try so very hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wears a refreshed smile. Still in Love 
had successfully managed to lose weight.
